meta.title: One Move
meta.instructions: White to move. Only one of the four moves is checkmate: find it. Every wrong move is a check or a threat that fails, and costs a life.

quiz_questions.body: if locked and len(opts) > 0 then content_whys else map(content_names, n => n + ': White mates in one')

whys: Re8: the king’s own pawns block every escape square.
Qxf7: the bishop guards f7. Bxf7+ lets the king run to e7.
Nf7: walled in by its own rook and pawns, the king can’t move.
Rh7: the knight guards the rook. Rb8+ lets the king out to g7.
Qg7: the bishop on f6 guards the queen. Qf8+ just loses her.
Rh8: the other rook holds the 7th rank. Rg8+ lets the king out.
Qxh7: bishop and knight both guard h7. Bxh7+ lets the king hide.
Rd8: the king’s own pawns wall off its escape squares.
